overall_goal: Organize the kitchen workspace by rearranging food items and clearing utensils

goals.description: Rearrange the food items and plates on the countertop
goals.rationale: The person moves the baguette end between plates and adjusts the positions of the plates containing food.

goals.description: Move the butter knife to the sink for washing
goals.rationale: The person transfers the butter knife between hands and places it by the sink to be washed.
